subject: Biology
b6_reason: Inbreeding's real advantages are raising homozygosity so harmful recessives are exposed and eliminated and superior genes accumulate; decreased productivity after continuous inbreeding is inbreeding depression, a disadvantage, not an advantage.
b6_note: Option 1 says inbreeding 'decreases' homozygosity, which is also factually wrong (inbreeding increases homozygosity), so it too could be read as not-an-advantage; flagging this overlap as a possible faulty/ambiguous question.
